image_description: A group of chickens foraging in a grassy field. The primary subject is a rooster (cock) in the lower-left center, displaying vibrant orange, gold, and black plumage with a red comb and wattle. Several hens with mottled brown, black, and grey feathers surround it. Two white eggs are visible on the ground near the hens. The background consists of green grass.
